args.title: Prevent adding empty rows in writeXlsx function
args.body:
File: src/export/xlsx.ts

Modify the implementation of the writeXlsx function to check the input data and avoid adding an empty row when the input contains a blank line.

label: bug
file: src/export/xlsx.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The function writeXlsx adds rows that can lead to a Malformed row error when the last row is empty due to a blank line. This change will prevent adding such empty rows.
